title: Rotate a session transcript without reading it: seek to the cut and copy the tail, instead of parsing every line
description: Rotate a session transcript without reading it: seek to the cut and copy the tail, instead of parsing every line
acceptance_criteria: A transcript rotation costs no measurable memory: 0.1MB against 229MB for the original implementation and 96MB for a streaming-but-still-parsing one. Rotation seeks to the cut point rather than scanning the dropped region, reads the bytes field each event already records rather than parsing events, and copies with IO.copy_stream so bytes never enter Ruby. The accounting stays exact and cursors keep their meaning. Full suite and lint pass.
